title: words roll with waves churning frosted thoughts through the chop of truths sought atop peacful crests and violent troughs three knots of naught stanza
summary: words roll with waves churning frosted thoughts through the chop of truths sought atop peacful crests and violent troughs three knots of naught stanzas swell as wind bells chime through a rusted, but trusted buoy #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
words roll with waves
churning frosted thoughts
through the chop of
truths sought
atop peacful crests and
violent troughs
three knots of naught
stanzas swell
as wind bells
chime through a
rusted, but trusted
buoy
#smallpoems
